meta.title: Fundraisers by Plant-for-the-Planet
meta.description: Turn a birthday, a wedding or a company milestone into trees in the ground. Fundraisers by Plant-for-the-Planet.

hero.title: Ask your people to <accent>plant with you.</accent>
hero.lead: A birthday. A wedding. The day your company turns ten. Fundraisers turns the moments that matter to you into trees in the ground, and makes it easy for the people you love to join in.

orbit.alt: People giving to one cause, shown as a ring around a tree

who.title: Built for you
who.lead: Whether you are in a suit, a party hat or muddy boots. The same tool for very different evenings.

c2.title: Trees instead of flowers, in memory of Rosa

c3.title: Grandpa Henk turns 70. So does the oak he planted.

s1.scene: Six friends are hiking the Alps this summer. Every summit they reach plants another hundred trees.

m1.label: The plan
m1.text: One link in the group chat, with a photo of the route and a goal of 600 trees.

m2.label: The hike
m2.text: Friends back home give at every summit, and each gift gets a thank-you on the spot.

m3.label: Years later
m3.text: Somewhere in Ghana, their forest is taller than any of them.

s2.scene: When Rosa died, her family asked for trees instead of flowers.

m1.label: The notice
m1.text: One line in the funeral notice, and a page with her favourite photo.

m2.label: The weeks after
m2.text: Friends and neighbours give in her name, and each gift gets a personal thank-you.

m3.label: Every spring
m3.text: Her forest grows, and the family visits it on her birthday.

s3.scene: Henk's father planted an oak the day Henk was born. This year they both turn 70.

m1.label: The family
m1.text: The grandchildren build the page, with a photo of Henk under his oak.

m2.label: The party
m2.text: Cousins from four countries give, and Henk reads every thank-you out loud.

m3.label: The next 70 years
m3.text: A new forest, all younger than the oak, all growing.

c1.title: Every kilometre plants a tree: the Fernmoor team run

c2.title: Volunteer day: plant in the morning, raise by the evening

c3.title: No gift boxes this Christmas: a forest for our clients

s1.scene: Fernmoor's running club has a race every spring. This year every kilometre plants a tree.

m1.label: Before the run
m1.text: One page in Fernmoor's colours, shared with colleagues, friends and family.

m2.label: On the day
m2.text: Supporters give while the runners are out, and the total climbs.

m3.label: Afterwards
m3.text: Tired legs, and a forest with the whole team's name on it.

s2.scene: Once a year, everyone at Halden & Co. takes a day off to volunteer. This year they also raise.

m1.label: The morning
m1.text: Teams plant trees together in the local park.

m2.label: The afternoon
m2.text: Everyone shares the page, and friends and family give from home.

m3.label: The evening
m3.text: The total goes up on the big screen, and everyone sees what one day can do.

s3.scene: Every December, Moosberg Studio sends clients a gift box. This year they send a link instead.

m1.label: The card
m1.text: A Christmas card with one link: no chocolates this year, a forest instead.

m2.label: The weeks before Christmas
m2.text: Clients and partners give, and every gift gets a thank-you.

m3.label: January
m3.text: The studio shares the total, a forest grown in its clients’ name.

organizations.label: Restoration organizations
organizations.heading: Raise for the forest you are growing.

forest.alt: Photos from Plant-for-the-Planet restoration projects in Ghana, Mexico and Spain

s1.scene: A wildfire burned part of your restoration site last summer.

m1.label: The appeal
m1.text: You start a fundraiser for the replanting, with photos from the ground.

m2.label: The response
m2.text: Partners and past donors share it, and gifts arrive from people you have never met.

m3.label: The new season
m3.text: Paid out on schedule through ForestCloud, the seedlings go in before the rains.

s2.scene: Your project has just planted its millionth tree.

m1.label: The milestone
m1.text: You open a fundraiser to celebrate, and to fund the next million.

m2.label: The evening
m2.text: A live event in Stage Mode, with the total climbing on the big screen.

m3.label: Afterwards
m3.text: Every gift paid out through ForestCloud, on the platform’s regular schedule.

s3.scene: Earth Day is coming, and you want the world to see your forest.

m1.label: The weeks before
m1.text: A page in your colours, with your photo and your story.

m2.label: Earth Day
m2.text: Schools and companies pick your project and share it for the day.

m3.label: The day after
m3.text: Your share arrives on schedule, and many new supporters stay.

how.title: Up and running in a few minutes!

start.title: Start
start.text: Give it a name, a goal and an end date. Pick a cause.

make.title: Make it yours
make.text: Add your photo, tell your story, choose your colours. Preview it before anyone else sees it.

share.title: Share
share.text: Send your link. Add co-hosts. Let Explore do some of the work for you.

grow.title: Watch it grow
grow.text: See every gift arrive in your dashboard. Say thank you.

projects.title: Find the cause you care about.
projects.lead: Every project is run by people who live there and know the land. And every one meets the minimum standards set by the <standards>Restoration Project Review Board</standards>, a panel of outside experts. <verification>How projects are verified</verification>.
projects.bouquets: Or start from a bouquet of causes
projects.globeAlt: A globe with a dot for every place where a restoration project grows

customize.title: Nothing here looks like a template. Unless you want it to.
customize.lead: A fundraiser page is yours from the first pixel to the thank-you note. Start from a theme, or shuffle until one feels right, then change anything.

themes.title: Endless styles
themes.text: Multiple themes to start from, Spring to Midnight, light or dark. One tap to switch, one to shuffle, then change anything.

colours.title: Your colours
colours.text: Pick an accent, or a custom one with the eyedropper. Solid or gradient backgrounds with your own stops.

type.title: Your type
type.text: Choose a font you like for titles and body. Playfair for a wedding, Poppins for a launch.

backgrounds.title: Patterns, images, logos
backgrounds.text: A tiled pattern, a full photo, or your partner logo behind the page, tinted and dialled in with opacity.

motion.title: A little magic
motion.text: Confetti for the birthday. Snow for December. Hearts for the wedding. Fireworks for the launch.

story.title: Your story
story.text: A cover photo, a description with links and video, and a thank-you note in your words when a gift lands.

stage.title: Ready for the big speech?
stage.p1: Raise in style. Put your fundraiser on the big screen with a live total, a leaderboard and every gift popping up as it lands. Guests scan the code and give from their seat.

demo.title: Future Forest Gala 2026
demo.description: Fernmoor GmbH and friends, for the forests of Ghana

s1.title: Tonight becomes a forest.
s1.description: Every gift in this room takes root in Ghana and keeps growing long after the last song.

s2.title: It started with a child.
s2.description: Plant-for-the-Planet began with a nine-year-old and one tree. Tonight we add ours.

s3.title: Every tree is cared for.
s3.description: Planted by people who live there, looked after for years, until it is a forest again.

stage.devices: Any smart TV, Chromecast, Apple TV or projector. Nothing to install.

more.title: Every fundraiser also carries <accent>Plant-for-the-Planet.</accent>
more.p1: A share of every fundraiser goes to Plant-for-the-Planet itself. That is what keeps the whole journey moving: children who become Climate Justice Ambassadors, forests that come back in Mexico, Ghana and Spain, free tools for the people doing the planting, and a voice in the rooms where forest policy is made.
more.p2: So when your friends give to your birthday forest, they are also giving a nine-year-old somewhere the chance to plant her first tree.
more.photoAlt: Climate Justice Ambassadors at a Plant-for-the-Planet Academy

forests.text: Mexico, Ghana and Spain. 36 million trees and counting.

tools.text: Open source, commission-free tools to scale forest restoration. 300+ projects in over 60 countries.

voice.text: Advocacy for forests and climate justice.

cta.title: Pick a moment that matters to you.
cta.lead: Give it a name and a goal tonight. Everything else can wait until tomorrow.
